description: Busy, rate-limit and error-message vectors shared by @byos/core (TypeScript) and ByosCore (Swift). Times are Unix seconds; `now` is the clock for every case. A reset time in a message is the token {reset}: tests format it with a stub that returns that token.

claude-subscription.name: Claude
claude-subscription.sharedLimitNote: Claude.ai and Claude Code count toward the same limit.

rate limit, first try: wait the first backoff

decide.name: a bare 429 Error is a refusal, not a limit
retry-after longer than the backoff wins
retry-after past the wait limit fails at once and cools down that long
